title: AnalyticsWorkspaceAsset - Data API
description: Represents a Tableau Next asset in a workspace. This object is available in API version 54.0 and later.

ActivePromotionRequestId.description: The ID of the active promotion request for the workspace asset. This field is a relationship field.

AnalyticsWorkspaceId.description: The ID of the Tableau Next workspace the asset is associated with. This field is a relationship field.

AssetId.description: The ID of the asset. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

AssetType.description: The type of asset. Possible values are: AnalyticsDashboard—Analytics Dashboard AnalyticsVisualization—Analytics Visualization MktCalculatedInsightObject—Calculated Insight Object MktDataConnection—Data Cloud Connection MktDataLakeObject—Data Lake Object MktDataModelObject—Data Model Object SemanticModel—Semantic Model

AssetUsageType.description: The type of usage for the asset. Possible values are: Created Referenced

HistoricalPromotionStatus.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
HistoricalPromotionStatus.description: The historical promotion status for the asset. Possible values are: pending promoted unpromoted

MetadataSourceType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
MetadataSourceType.description: The source type of the asset metadata. Possible values are: Promoted Reused

special_access_rules: To access this object, you must have Tableau Next enabled in your org and a Tableau Next permission set.
